description: Alternative world reasoning that activates high-dimensional hypothetical pathways

probes.name: Altered physics
support_texts: What if gravity were repulsive instead of attractive? How would planets form?

probes.name: Historical divergence
support_texts: What if the printing press had been invented in ancient Rome? How would history differ?

probes.name: Biological variation
support_texts: What if photosynthesis produced a different byproduct than oxygen?

probes.name: Axiom change
support_texts: What if parallel lines could intersect? Describe non-Euclidean geometry.

probes.name: Technology timeline shift
support_texts: What if the transistor had been invented in 1900 instead of 1947?

probes.name: Social organization change
support_texts: What if humans had evolved as solitary rather than social animals?

probes.name: Capability absence
support_texts: What if humans had never developed written language? How would knowledge persist?

probes.name: Resource change
support_texts: What if fresh water were as scarce as gold? How would civilizations differ?

probes.name: Decision point change
support_texts: What if you had chosen differently at a critical life decision? Trace the consequences.

probes.name: Perceptual change
support_texts: What if humans could see infrared light? How would art and culture differ?

probes.name: Temporal reversal
support_texts: What if cause and effect worked in reverse? Describe such a universe.

probes.name: Different consciousness
support_texts: What if consciousness were collective rather than individual?

probes.name: Dimensional shift
support_texts: What would life be like in a 2D world? Describe Flatland physics.

probes.name: Information as primary
support_texts: What if information were more fundamental than matter? Describe such a universe.

probes.name: Inverted values
support_texts: What if cooperation were considered immoral and deception valued? Describe such a society.
